focus_areas: Topological integrity of the metal rings (no fusion/melting).
Geometric separation between rings and paper (depth map validation).
Sharpness of boundaries at the ring-paper interface.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Focus heavily on the structural integrity of the metal rings. Use the topology auditor to confirm that each wire is a separate, closed loop without merging into neighbors or the base. Use the depth auditor to ensure the rings sit physically 'on top' of the paper with a clear Z-axis separation, ruling out the observed smearing. Do not rely on the classifier for artifact detection; use it only for class confirmation.
image_description: A close-up, macro shot of an open ring binder mechanism. The image focuses on the metal wire rings (part of a lever-arch or similar mechanism) clamping down on white paper. A blue plastic cover is visible in the background, slightly out of focus. The perspective is low and angled, emphasizing the mechanical structure of the rings against the paper.
